idea-plugin.name: AI Chat Selection
idea-plugin.description:
Syncs selected IntelliJ editor text into JetBrains AI Chat.

  • Adds and refreshes the current @selection reference.
  • Opens the current AI Chat when needed and focuses its input.
  • Ignores selections made inside the AI Chat input.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Added selection-first Marketplace metadata.
  • Changed the AI Chat action to keep the view open and focus its input.

action.description: Open the current AI Chat when needed and focus its text box
